subject: POC acceptance metrics + recommended deployment path for Vectorix Labs
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC acceptance metrics + recommended deployment path for Vectorix Labs

Hi Jenna / Vectorix team —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture a concise recap, propose a POC plan that balances speed vs fidelity, and call out ownership and timelines so we can lock in kickoff next week.

Recap (key asks you shared):
- Evaluation goal: validate document-assistant accuracy for clinical protocols and triage guidance across ~5 representative workflows.
- Scale target: ~1k concurrent daily users during POC peak; production expected to be larger but unknown.
- Security: must support customer-managed keys and in-region data controls.
- Latency sensitivity: interactive experience — target 95th percentile under 400ms for short prompts (~64 tokens).

Proposed POC approach (3-stage, quick ramp):
1) Hosted API quick-start (2 weeks):
   - Purpose: verify end-to-end behavior with your prompt set and functional acceptance criteria.
   - What we need from you: 5 canonical prompt/test cases, sample traffic profile (QPS pattern), and realistic anonymized test docs.
   - Deliverable: evaluation report with accuracy/QA, token-cost estimate, and latency baseline.

2) Dedicated sandbox (optional, 2–3 weeks):
   - Purpose: simulate production throughput and measure sustained latency + cost at scale without VPC setup.
   - When to pick: if hosted results show model-level acceptance but you want throughput cost/latency characterization.

3) VPC trial (if required, 3–4 weeks):
   - Purpose: run in your VPC (private networking + KMS) to validate security posture and egress controls.
   - When to pick: if Hosted/Dedicated cannot meet data residency or KMS constraints.

Success criteria (draft — please confirm/edit):
- Functional: per-prompt accuracy >= 88% on 5 core workflows (scored by Vectorix SMEs).
- Safety/regulatory: no PHI leakage in test set, support for KMS in VPC if flagged.
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 400ms for 64-token prompts under a 50 RPS sustained load in Dedicated simulation.
- Cost signal: token cost projection for steady-state 100k monthly requests (we'll provide a $/1k token estimate post-hosted run).

Ownership and next steps:
- Vectorix: deliver anonymized sample docs, canonical prompt set, and network contact for VPC checklist by EOD Thursday 6/11.
- Redwood (Alex): draft hosted test harness + eval dashboard; propose kickoff 6/15.
- Redwood (Ben): scope Dedicated sandbox and resource estimate; will confirm instance sizing by 6/12.
- Redwood (Priyom): security checklist for KMS/VPC and required audit artifacts.

Attachments: poc-success-metrics.xlsx (template), network-inventory.pdf (example VPC questionnaire).

If this looks right I'll update the Drive doc and send a calendar invite for the 6/15 start.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez

Alex —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick confirmation from our side:
- We'll provide 5 canonical prompts and a 2000-doc anonymized sample set by Thu 6/11 EOD.
- Network contact: Mark Liu (mark.liu@vectorixlabs.com) — he can handle the VPC questionnaire.
- Priority: we want to validate accuracy and safety first (Hosted kickoff is fine), but VPC/KMS support is a hard requirement before any production rollout.

One ask: can Redwood's hosted phase be configured to never persist raw docs to storage (even temporarily)? We need to ensure that the hosted trial meets our internal risk bar before we run our sample set.

Also — pricing sensitivity: we need a ballpark of POC token spend for the hosted run so leadership can approve credits.

Happy to kick off on 6/15 as proposed.

All — quick infra notes based on Alex's plan and Mark's coming VPC info:

1) Hosted run (no persistence mode): we can run requests with transient-only logging. We will disable long-term storage of request payloads and only capture aggregated telemetry for the eval. Need Jenna's explicit confirmation to proceed with that data posture.

2) Dedicated sandbox sizing recs (ballpark):
   - 1 x 80GB memory GPU + 4 vCPU proxy for a 50 RPS sustained sim (model: gpt-open-13b-quant).
   - Estimated token cost for a 2-week hosted test (based on your sample size): ~$1,200–2,500 depending on prompt length; Dedicated sandbox infra cost estimate adds ~$4,500 for the reserved sandbox window (customer-visible estimate).

3) VPC notes: once Mark shares network constraints, we'll provide a checklist. Priyom — I'll need the minimal set of audit/KMS docs to send over so they can sign the trial NDA/engage security review.

I'll put the exact instance sizing and a Firm Cost Estimate in the Drive doc by EOD 6/12.

-ben
